_comment: app runs bin/app.ts directly through tsx instead of a compiled dist/bin/app.js. The workspace root is ESM (package.json "type": "module") under NodeNext resolution; ts-node's ESM loader is finicky in that combination, and a prior `npm run build` step would make `cdk synth` depend on build freshness. tsx is a fast, zero-config TS runner that handles NodeNext + ESM directly, so the CDK app always runs from source. `npm run build` (tsc -b) still type-checks this workspace as a composite project — tsx only replaces execution, not type-checking.
